# Land Development Specialists LLC

> Land development consulting for developers, homebuilders, and landowners in Southern California (Orange, Riverside, and Los Angeles counties). Principal: Brian Woods. More than 40 years in land development, including VP-level land development roles with D.R. Horton, Foremost Communities, Pulte/Del Webb, and Richmond American Homes. More than 13,000 residential lots entitled and constructed; 8+ master plans.

Phone: (760) 271-1081 · Email: brian@landdevspec.net · Mail: P.O. Box 5833, Huntington Beach, CA 92615 (mailing address, not a staffed office)

## Services
- [Land development feasibility study and due diligence](https://landdevspec.net/services/land-development-feasibility-study/): Riverside County (including Corona) and Southern California
- [Residential land entitlements, CEQA, tentative tract maps](https://landdevspec.net/services/residential-land-entitlements/)
- [Residential subdivision development, 50 to 200 lots](https://landdevspec.net/services/residential-subdivision-development/)
- [Land development project management and construction management](https://landdevspec.net/services/land-development-project-management/)
- [Value engineering](https://landdevspec.net/services/value-engineering/)
